unlisted_practices: Document all feature extraction hyperparameter choices explicitly and perform sensitivity analyses of their impact on feature stability.
Apply harmonization strategies such as ComBat when pooling multicenter imaging data.
Quantify segmentation variability using metrics such as the Dice coefficient.
Validate automatic segmentation rigorously rather than trusting it blindly.
Follow IBSI standards for radiomic feature extraction and reporting.
Limit the number of model features relative to sample size to avoid overfitting.
Use cross-validation and hyperparameter tuning when building radiomic models.
Assess model explainability with methods such as SHAP or LIME.
Share code and trained models through open science practices to facilitate clinical integration.
